def validate(delta, x, trials=3):
    """Check that delta is a genuine hyperplane through x: crossing the
    same hyperplane at other points must give the same gradient jump."""
    w = delta / np.linalg.norm(delta)
    ok = 0
    for _ in range(trials):
        v = rng.normal(size=DIM)
        v -= np.dot(v, w) * w
        v *= rng.uniform(0.05, 0.5) / np.linalg.norm(v)
        y = x + v
        eps = 1e-4
        dl = grad(y + eps * w, 1e-6) - grad(y - eps * w, 1e-6)
        if np.linalg.norm(dl - delta) < 1e-3 * np.linalg.norm(delta):
            ok += 1
    return ok >= 2
